inputTokens.method: Non-cached input tokens from provider usage accounting in local logs (parsed by ccusage).

cacheCreationTokens.method: Cache-write tokens from provider usage accounting in local logs (parsed by ccusage).

cacheReadTokens.method: Cache-read tokens from provider usage accounting in local logs (parsed by ccusage).

totalTokens.method: Deterministic sum of the four provider-reported token components.

estimatedCostUsd.method: ccusage price-table estimate. Not an authoritative invoice; excluded from exact token totals.

models.method: Model identifiers reported by the provider logs.

measurement.note: Token counts are provider-reported usage accounting or deterministic sums of them. Cost is an estimate from a price table, not an invoice, and is never added into token totals. Activity volume is not a measure of skill, productivity, or employability.

opportunity.typicalProjectSize: A few hours to multi-week engagements
opportunity.computeCostRange: Efficiency-minded; heavy cache reuse keeps per-task compute low
opportunity.note: Availability, engagement, and compensation are set by the member. They are self-declared preferences, not verified terms.

efficiency.note: Efficiency signals, not a ranking. Producing the same verified result with fewer tokens is better. These are context for the activity figures — cost per outcome requires connected outcomes, which are not built yet.

verification.label: Device-signed
verification.basis: The published snapshot was signed by a key held on this device and has not changed since. This proves integrity, not identity, and not that the source logs were genuine.

verification.label: Collector-observed
verification.basis: AI activity was read from the provider's own usage accounting in local logs on this device (96 active days; 6 project(s) seen locally). This is device-local observation, not independent confirmation.

verification.label: Identity-linked
verification.basis: The member published a key-signed proof under an external account; your browser verifies it live (see the identity badge above). This proves control of that account, not legal identity.

verification.label: Provider-attested
verification.basis: No provider has independently confirmed this usage (no OAuth usage API, billing export, or enterprise attestation is connected yet). This is a stronger tier when available.

verification.label: Benchmark-assessed
verification.basis: No practical, reproducible assessment has been completed and attached to this profile.

verification.label: Third-party-confirmed
verification.basis: No client, employer, repository owner, or research organization has confirmed an outcome. 6 artifact(s) are collector-observed, which shows local activity but not authorship, quality, or results.

verification.label: Self-submitted
verification.basis: Identity, headline, links, work artifacts, and any outcomes were entered by the member and are not independently verified.

profile.note: Identity fields are self-submitted and unverified. Activity is derived from measured, provider-reported usage. Activity volume is evidence of practice, not a measure of skill, seniority, or employability.

checks.name: No future-dated activity
checks.detail: All activity is dated on or before the snapshot date.

checks.name: Plausible daily volume
checks.detail: No day exceeds the implausible-volume threshold.

checks.name: Well-formed totals
checks.detail: All totals are finite and non-negative.

checks.name: Recognized model families
checks.detail: All model names match known provider families.

checks.name: No large retroactive backfill
checks.detail: No unusual retroactive changes versus the last snapshot.

integrity.note: All automated integrity checks passed. These detect statistical tells, not fraud, and a passing result does not prove the source logs were genuine.

claude.note: Event-level, deduplicated by provider message id. Reconciles to within 0.05% of ccusage across all measured days.

codex.note: Event-level. Codex re-emits a turn’s usage without advancing its cumulative counter in roughly 15% of sessions, so totals may overstate by up to ~7%. Treated as approximate.

verification.proves: The hash proves the published snapshot was not altered after generation. It does not prove the private source logs were immutable, only that this public file is intact.

signature.proves: This snapshot was produced by a collector holding this device key and has not been altered since signing.
doesNotProve: It does not prove the provider source logs were genuine or unmodified.
It does not prove the human identity behind this device key.
It is a device attestation, not a third-party audit.
